algorithm: RC4 audited max_live baseline + runtime current overlays; buy band=floor(90% audited MAX)

semantics.buy: T0 opportunistic BUY ceiling derived as floor(90% of audited MAX)
semantics.wait: controlled range from BUY+1 through audited MAX
semantics.stop: audited maximum T0; above this PASS before live overlay adjustments
semantics.dynamic_note: Dynamic MAX may change only from allowed current overlays and recorded auction state; Kapitals/market500 are never MAX.
